verdict.rationale: MailerSend's first-party MCP server documents managing 'suppressions' as a standardized tool. That is the product's own programmatic interface over its suppression data, but the pack contains no REST endpoint docs for suppression lists. Bounce and unsubscribe tracking (docs-13) and webhooks are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented REST/API endpoints to list, add and delete suppressions; explicit separate hard-bounce, complaint and unsubscribe list types; evidence of automatic blocking of re-sends to suppressed addresses; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce

citations.quote: This server enables AI assistants to send emails and SMS, manage domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities, users, and many other things through standardized MCP tools.
